title: Telecoms sink as SpaceX acquires spectrum for its own mobile service
summary: Verizon fell alongside AT&T and T-Mobile after SpaceX secured 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management for Starlink Mobile, raising the prospect of a well-funded new national carrier.

title: SpaceX lines up 800 MHz spectrum for Starlink Mobile, threatening the big carriers
summary: SpaceX agreed to license up to 14 MHz of paired 800 MHz spectrum from Grain Management to power Starlink Mobile, a step toward becoming a full U.S. wireless carrier. Telecom stocks sold off on the new competitive threat; T-Mobile fell about 13%.

title: Musk says Terafab is in talks with TSMC
summary: Elon Musk said his Terafab chip project is negotiating a dedicated TSMC facility for Tesla, SpaceX and xAI, raising doubts about Intel's expected foundry role. Intel fell about 4% before the open.

title: S&P 500 closes above 7,800 for the first time
summary: Tech gains and cooler bond yields carried the index to a record close.

title: Gold ends September down 8.5% at $4,176/oz
summary: The 10-year yield rose 53bp to 5.3% and the dollar gained 2%, while about $12B of futures positions were liquidated. Gold ETFs still took in roughly $10B over the month.

title: Fed raises rates a quarter point to 3.75%–4%
summary: The FOMC lifted its target range by 25 basis points and signaled more hikes may follow. The Dow fell about 600 points as bond yields climbed.

title: Fed's first hike in three years weighs on gold as yields climb
summary: The quarter-point hike, and signals that more could follow, pushed the 10-year Treasury yield toward a 19-year high and raised the cost of holding non-yielding gold.

title: Oracle cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubles; backlog near $664B
summary: Fiscal Q1 results beat estimates on triple-digit growth in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, with remaining performance obligations of about $664B.

title: Broadcom AI chip revenue triples to $16.7B
summary: Q3 AI semiconductor revenue rose about 221%, and management outlined AI revenue of $115B for fiscal 2027.

title: Nvidia Q2 revenue doubles to $96.2B; outlook implies about 70% growth
summary: Revenue rose 106% from a year earlier with gross margin steady at 75%, though management expects a dip next quarter from memory costs. Its outlook implied growth near twice what analysts expected. Shares closed up 8.7% the next day on about double normal volume.

title: Walmart beats and raises, and the stock sells off
summary: Q2 results topped estimates and full-year guidance went up, yet shares fell sharply on the day.

title: Lilly beats and raises full-year guidance
summary: Q2 revenue passed $23B on demand for its weight-loss and diabetes drugs, and the company lifted its 2026 outlook.

title: AMD beats on revenue, slips after hours
summary: Q2 revenue of $11.53B and EPS of $1.66 topped consensus but missed the whisper number, and shares fell in extended trading.

title: Amazon beats as AWS growth reaches about 37%
summary: AWS revenue rose to $42.2B with record margins and total revenue passed $200B, although current-quarter guidance was softer. Shares rose about 7% after hours.

title: Apple posts a record June quarter, and the stock slips anyway
summary: Revenue of $109.4B and EPS of $2.02 both beat estimates, but shares fell about 4% in after-hours trading.

title: Microsoft beats on strong Azure growth
summary: Fiscal Q4 results topped estimates on the strength of Azure. Shares surged the next session as investors rewarded its AI cloud business while punishing Meta's spending.

title: Fed holds rates steady at its July meeting
summary: The Fed left its target range unchanged while Treasury yields rose, on the same evening Microsoft and Meta reported.

title: Meta's revenue outlook disappoints; free cash flow down about 91%
summary: Heavy AI spending collapsed second-quarter free cash flow and the revenue forecast came in light. Shares fell 8–9% the next day, extending a record losing streak.

title: Tesla misses on profit as auto margins shrink
summary: Deliveries hit a record of about 480,000, but operating income fell roughly 57%, auto margins excluding credits slipped to 16.3% and free cash flow went negative. Shares fell about 16% over two sessions.

title: Alphabet's capex doubles as Google Cloud grows 82%
summary: Cloud revenue reached about $24.8B and total revenue grew roughly 24%, but capital spending doubled to about $45B, free cash flow turned negative and buybacks were suspended. Shares fell about 6.5% over two sessions.

title: UnitedHealth beats and raises 2026 EPS outlook to $19.50–$20.00
summary: Second-quarter results came in well ahead of estimates across its businesses and full-year guidance moved up.

title: Netflix guides Q3 below estimates
summary: Second-quarter results beat, but the third-quarter forecast disappointed and the company said it will report engagement less often. Shares hit a 52-week low the next day.

title: JPMorgan Q2 beats as investment banking drives growth
summary: Strong dealmaking and trading lifted second-quarter results above expectations.
